issues.description: The RollerCoaster attribute 'numberOfLoopings' is declared as protected in the solution implementation, but the UML in the problem statement marks it as private ('-numberOfLoopings: int'). The exercise text instructs students to create attributes according to the UML. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended access level for the attribute and deviates from the UML specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of numberOfLoopings consistent with the UML: declare it private in RollerCoaster (private int numberOfLoopings) and keep the public getter getNumberOfLoopings(). Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to explicitly allow protected visibility if that was intended.
